title: Double Drip Raspberry & Apple 50/50 E-Liquid
description: Some flavours never go out of fashion, but it takes Double Drip to make the classic cordial taste of Raspberry and Apple trendy again. This perfectly balanced e-liquid layers ripe, juicy, tangy raspberries over luscious, orchard-fresh green apples for an irresistibly smooth, sweet and refreshing all-day vape that makes your taste buds come alive with intense fruit flavour. Double Drip Coil Sauce E-Liquid is a high-quality vape juice brand proudly manufactured right here in the United Kingdom. Browse the entire Double Drip range and find the perfect juice for your e-cigarette setup. Double Drip is available in a variety of formulations to suit a range of kits, including sub ohm (high-VG), 50/50 e-liquid , nicotine salt vape juice , and 50ml shortfills for use with starter vape kits , high-powered e cig kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
